about_the_game:
Hamlet’s a girl. She’s a werewolf. And this winter? She’s got problems.

There’s a murder. There’s a throne to retake. The Fae are acting up. The kingdom is not okay, and Hamlet apparently needs to get their collective stuffing together just enough so that they can maybe fix it all.

This is a story-driven visual novel where your emotions are your attributes. Choose how Hamlet reacts, and certain stats go up, while others stay the same. Your fluctuating emotional state wiill unlock roads to go down, romantic targets to pursue, and sometimes (okay, so often times) ridiculous chaos. Or miss entire paths completely due to the choices you've made. 

  • Visual novel, narrative

  • Branching paths based on multiple emotional states

  • Multiple endings

  • Three romantic options (or one if you play your cards right)

  • Save or destroy an entire holiday (possibly)

  • Stock photo backgrounds up the wazoo

content_descriptors.notes: Swearing, talk about death, sometimes talk about suicide, killing.

short_description: Guide Hamlet (now a Girl *and* a Werewolf) as she deals with a murder mystery, a usurped throne, and a cursed sledding competition. Her emotions are your stats, so.... emote wisely. Or impulsively. Or with shame. It’s her kingdom. Everyone else is just tolerated in it.
